Source the optical, electronic, fluidic and mechanical components

Apart from the 3D printed parts, Cytkit requires a set of specialised components: optical, electronic and fluidic, as well as a few non-printed mechanical components. These are listed below along with recommended sources.

We intend to supply full kits shortly, with all recommended components, to make it easier to get started with Cytkit.

Source the safety equipment

  1. Laser safety glasses

Source the optical components

  1. Laser focus lens spherical
  2. Laser focus lens cylindrical
  3. Blazed reflection grating
  4. Neutral density filter
  5. Dichroic longpass filter at 45 degrees (beamsplitter)
  6. Dichroic longpass filter at 0 degrees
  7. Coloured glass longpass filter
  8. Condensing lens
  9. Spectrum focusing lens
  10. SSC focusing lens
  11. 2x F7D8 aspherical lens
  12. 488 nm laser module
  13. Laser collimating lens
  14. Laser heatsink
  15. Band pass dichroic filter
  16. Cylindrical correction lens
  17. 5 mm laser blocking filter

Source the fluidic components

  1. Vacuum pump for sheath
  2. Peristaltic pump for sample
  3. Bottom-of-bottle filter
  4. 2 m Silicone tubing 2 mm OD 1 mm ID
  5. 1 m Silicone tubing 3.2 mm OD 1.6 mm ID
  6. 1 m Silicone tubing 6 mm OD 4 mm ID
  7. Tube barb union 1.6x2.4
  8. Tube barb union 1.6x3.2
  9. Tube barb union 2.4x6.4
  10. Quartz cuvette or thick-walled capillary
  11. Pressure-resistant bottle
  12. PEEK tubing 1.6mm OD 0.25mm ID
  13. Nitrile black O-rings ID 1mm CS 1mm

Source the electronic components

According to the configuration you are building:

For the Cytkit 1S-1F configuration:

  1. Amplified photodiode (Thorlabs PDA10)
  2. Photomultiplier tube module (Hamamatsu H10732)
  3. USB oscilloscope (Picoscope 5000 series)
  4. Vacuum pump controller board
  5. Stepper motor controller board
  6. BNC (Male) to BNC (Male) cable, 1 m
  7. SMA (Female) to BNC (Male) adapter
  8. Linear Power Supply
  9. Laboratory Power Supply
  10. USB camera module
  11. (Optional) 3mm F3 round white LED
  12. (Optional) 16k resistor

For the Cytkit 2S-14F configuration:

All electronic components are available in the Astute Devices Cytometry Electronics Set CYKIT-E-1, or in the Cytkit Full Kit CYKIT-K-1, anticipated to launch Q4 2026. Further details coming soon!

  1. Cytometer control board
  2. Photodiode board x2
  3. SiPM array board
  4. Pump connector board
  5. Interlock switches x2
  6. OLED display
  7. Blower fan
  8. USB camera module
  9. Ribbon connector set
  10. 36V DC power supply
  11. USB A to USB B cable

Source the mechanical components

  1. M3 self-tapping hex socket cap screws 25 mm
  2. M3 self-tapping posi head screws 6 mm
  3. M3 self-tapping posi head screws 8 mm
  4. M3 self-tapping posi head screws 10 mm
  5. M3 self-tapping posi head screws 12 mm
  6. M3 self-tapping posi head screws 16 mm
  7. M2.6 self-tapping posi head screws 6 mm
  8. M3 washers
  9. Stainless steel compression springs, 0.5 mm wire, 20 mm length, 6 mm diameter
  10. Stainless steel extension springs, 0.3 mm wire, 20 mm length, 6 mm diameter
  11. M4 thumb screws 10mm
  12. M4 hex socket bolt 10mm

Materials for alignment and testing

It is recommended to obtain the following materials for alignment and testing.

  1. Bright green fluorescent alignment beads
  2. Spherotech 3um 8-peak Rainbow Beads RCP-30-5A
  3. Spherotech 6um 6-peak Rainbow Beads RCP-60-5
  4. 5 mL flow cytometry test tubes
